messages.text:
"Add authorization to DocumentService.archive in src/service.ts. Actors have tenant,
user and role: admin, editor or viewer. Only active documents in the actor's tenant
are visible. Missing, deleted and foreign-tenant documents all throw Error('not found'),
even for admin. An admin may archive any visible document; an editor only one they own;
a viewer never may. Unauthorized visible requests throw Error('forbidden'). On success
set archived true and append exactly {actor: actor.user, document: id} to audit.
Repeating archive on an already archived visible document is a no-op, but still enforce
permission first. Failures must leave every document and audit entry unchanged.

You may change src/ and add or update checks/. Preserve public interfaces unless the request explicitly changes them. Run tsc -p tsconfig.json && node checks/public.cjs and describe the change.
"

content.text:
Implement authorization in service.ts archive. Rules:

- find document; if missing → 'not found'
- if document.deleted || document.tenant !== actor.tenant → 'not found'
- permission: admin → any visible; editor → owner === actor.user; viewer → never
- if not permitted and visible → 'forbidden'
- if archived already → no-op
- else archive(document, actor.user) appending {actor, document}.

Check repository.archive appends exactly {actor: actor.user, document: id} — yes it does.

Write updated service.ts and add checks. Maybe add my own checks file in checks/. Keep public behavior.

Done. `tsc -p tsconfig.json && node checks/public.cjs && node checks/auth.cjs` all pass.

**Change (src/service.ts only):**
- `DocumentService.archive` now enforces authorization in this order:
  1. **Not found** (message `'not found'`) when the id is missing, or the document is `deleted`, or belongs to a foreign tenant — this applies uniformly to all roles including admin, so it's checked before any role-based decision. Visibility = active (`!deleted`) and same tenant as the actor.
  2. **Forbidden** (message `'forbidden'`) for any failure message checks — Unauthorized get our own tl: admin always allowed on visible docs, editor allowed only when `document.owner === actor.user`, viewer never allowed.
  3. Only then is the mutation performed, and only when `!document.archived` (existing idempotent no-op behavior preserved, now permission-gated: repeating an already-archived visible doc first re-checks permission, so an unauthorized repeat still throws while an authorized repeat appends nothing new).
- Public interfaces are unchanged — `archive(actor, id): void` signature, repository, and types are untouched.

**Verification:** the shipped public check passes unchanged (admin archives `one`, repeat archive leaves exactly one audit entry, missing throws `not found`).

**New check (checks/auth.cjs)** covers the remaining矩阵: for each role (admin/editor/viewer), missing/deleted/foreign all throw `'not found'` with state fully unchanged; admin succeeds on a foreign-owned visible doc (+audit reorder check); editor succeeds on own, throws `'forbidden'` on other-owned; viewer throws `'forbidden'` on every visible doc; repeat-archive no-op preserves exactly one entry and still enforces permission on repeat; and every failure path leaves both `documents` (flags) and `audit` byte-identical.
